_comment: Bulwark: hf-watch-critical. Live workflow id x1q77bsw0oyhh0es77gla.
Autonomous liquidation defense, running entirely inside KeeperHub.
Why the whole decision lives server-side rather than calling back into the
agent: KeeperHub's cloud cannot reach a local /evaluate endpoint without a
public tunnel. Putting the CRITICAL tier in the workflow is also strictly
better for reliability, because the position stays defended even when the
agent process is down. The agent keeps the richer ARMED-tier cost/benefit
reasoning, where declining to act is the interesting behaviour.
healthy guard  execution auxlrmur691dcqop4yi7y, HF 1.3004, condition false,
live rescue    execution wzr411cjk9lq1xf2b5etd, HF 1.0400 -> 1.3192 in 26.5s
name: Bulwark: hf-watch-critical

data.label: Every 50 Blocks
data.description: 50 blocks is ~10 minutes on Sepolia, about 144 runs/day, which keeps us inside the 5000/month free tier.

data.label: Read Health Factor
data.description: Aave reports healthFactor with 18 decimals. No debt returns uint256 max.

data.label: Is Critical
data.description: HF below 1.05. A position with no debt returns uint256 max and is safely false.

data.label: Approve LINK
data.description: Refresh the pool allowance. Idempotent and cheap; without it the supply below reverts once the standing allowance is spent.

data.label: Top Up Collateral
data.description: Fixed 7 LINK top-up, sized to lift the demo position from HF 1.04 back above the 1.30 target. Amount is in base units, not human units. onBehalfOf is the watched position, not the keeper.

data.label: Verify Recovery
data.description: Re-read after the rescue. A rescue that executes but fails to clear the threshold is still a failure, and this puts the before/after pair in the audit trail.
